claims.label: Neff/Boring Joint Podcast Announced via Promotional Materials
claims.claim: Blake Neff and Jeremy Boring released promotional photo and audio/video promo clip announcing a joint podcast sitdown.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full released episode and compare its content against Saucelito's pre-release predictions and the host's commentary.

claims.label: Saucelito Predicted Podcast Content Pre-Release
claims.claim: Bobby Saucelito predicted, prior to release, that the Neff/Boring podcast would primarily consist of criticism of Candace Owens and Tucker Carlson, defense of TPUSA figures (Erica Kirk, Mikey McCoy, Frank Turk), and calls for lawsuits/jail time against the host.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Saucelito's specific predictions against the released episode segment-by-segment.

claims.label: Host Concurs Saucelito's Predictions Were "Almost Spot On"
claims.claim: The host explicitly concurs that Saucelito's pre-release predictions were "almost spot on" relative to the released promo clip.
claims.investigative_direction: Document the host's specific concurrence with each item of Saucelito's prediction list once the full episode is available.

claims.label: Neff Characterized Candace Owens as "Malicious, Hateful, Dishonest, Destructive"
claims.claim: In the Neff/Boring promo clip, Blake Neff stated that Candace Owens is a "malicious, hateful, dishonest, destructive actor in American life."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full Neff/Boring episode to confirm statement context and surrounding statements.

claims.label: Neff Stated Candace Wants Kirk's Killer to "Get Away With It"
claims.claim: In the Neff/Boring promo clip, Blake Neff stated that Candace Owens "wants the person who killed Charlie to get away with it."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify exact quote and context in the full Neff/Boring episode.

claims.label: Neff Asserted Tucker Carlson "Extended Maximum Grace" to Candace
claims.claim: In the Neff/Boring promo clip, Blake Neff stated that Tucker Carlson "has extended maximum grace to Candace Owens."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify exact quote and context in the full Neff/Boring episode.

claims.label: Boring X Post Claimed Owens Acts for Fame
claims.claim: Jeremy Boring posted on X that Candace Owens "does this largely on purpose" and that "all Candace cares about is fame and money. Nothing is beneath her."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original post via web archive to confirm exact wording and timestamp.

claims.label: Loomer X Post Claimed Save America Act Would Not Pass Before Midterms
claims.claim: Laura Loomer posted on X that the Save America Act would not pass before midterms and projected poor GOP midterm outcomes.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original post via web archive to confirm exact wording and timestamp.

claims.label: Mitchell X Post Characterized GOP as "Genuinely Useless"
claims.claim: Jamie Mitchell posted on X that "The GOP is genuinely useless" and that Democrats were projected to sweep the midterms.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original post via web archive to confirm exact wording and timestamp.

claims.label: Libs of TikTok X Post Cited 59% Democrat Sweep Projection
claims.claim: Libs of TikTok posted on X that prediction markets project Democrats at a 59% chance of sweeping both chambers of Congress in the 2026 midterms.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original post via web archive to confirm exact wording, timestamp, and the specific prediction market referenced.

claims.label: Vance Clip Asked Voters for "Another Chance" Citing Policy Achievements
claims.claim: JD Vance appeared on video asking voters to "give us another chance" and listing tax cuts (overtime, Social Security, tips), border/immigration success, and H-1B reform as accomplishments.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original venue/date of the Vance clip to anchor sourcing.

claims.label: Two Grey Dodge Challengers Arrived on UVU Campus Within ~20 Minutes of One Another
claims.claim: Two separate grey Dodge Challengers arrived on the UVU campus within approximately 20 minutes of each other on Sept 10 and both remained on campus for roughly an hour and a half before departing near-simultaneously.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain parking-garage entry/exit logs and timestamped surveillance footage to independently verify the arrivals of two distinct grey Challengers.

claims.label: "Waluigi" Vehicle Driver Made Multiple Parking Attempts in Empty Lot
claims.claim: The driver of the second grey Dodge Challenger (code-named "Waluigi") made over three to four parking attempts in the empty admin/admissions lot before parking.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original admin-lot surveillance footage to verify the number of attempts and any identifying characteristics of the driver.

claims.label: "Maroon Boy" Vehicle Parked at Top of UVU Structure for ~8 Minutes Before Relocating
claims.claim: The grey Dodge Challenger associated with the "Maroon Boy" was driven to the top level of the UVU parking structure and remained stationary there for approximately eight minutes, after which the subject relocated the vehicle to a lower level.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full top-of-structure surveillance footage to verify the eight-minute duration and any subject activity during that window.

claims.label: TMZ Footage at 8:07 AM Shows Robinson Already Parked Off Campus
claims.claim: TMZ surveillance footage timestamped 8:07 AM on Sept 10 shows Tyler Robinson walking toward the UVU campus, indicating he was already parked off campus at that time.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original TMZ footage with intact timestamps and any associated location metadata to independently confirm the timestamp and subject identification.

claims.label: Sept 15 Warrant Narrative Stated 8:28 AM Entry and 8:28–9:24 AM Wooded-Area Visit
claims.claim: The September 15 search warrant narrative (attributed to Agent Mortensson's review of UVU security video) stated that Robinson's Challenger entered the UVU parking structure at approximately 8:28 AM, that Robinson then visited a wooded area near where the rifle was later discovered, and that Robinson left the structure at approximately 9:32 AM.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the actual Sept 15 search warrant filing to verify the quoted language and its full surrounding narrative.

claims.label: Hull Preliminary Hearing Testimony Omitted the 8-Minute Top-of-Structure Stop and Revised the On-Campus Timeline
claims.claim: Agent David Hull's preliminary hearing testimony presented a campus timeline in which the "Maroon Boy" interacts with a TPUSA representative, departs, and returns on foot — omitting the approximately 8-minute top-of-structure stop and the 8:28–9:24 AM wooded-area visit described in the Sept 15 warrant.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the preliminary hearing transcript and audio/video to verify the specific omissions and re-orderings between the warrant narrative and Hull's testimony.

claims.label: Miss Noble Testimony Described Dodge Challenger with Bald Driver and Two Backseat Occupants
claims.claim: Neighbor Miss Noble and her husband reported observing a Dodge Challenger being driven by a bald person with two people in the back seat, parked in their neighborhood shortly after Officer Go forth's sighting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Miss Noble's interview transcript, witness statement, or sworn testimony to verify exact wording and to determine whether the Dodge Challenger identification was confirmed via plate or visual match.
